_policy: Accepted high/critical dependency advisories, checked by scripts/audit-check.mjs.
An entry is a maintainer decision, not a note: everything not listed here fails the
Security workflow. Keep them narrow (one advisory, one package, one tree), give a
reason that names the shipped or reachable path, and set an expiry so the call is
re-made rather than inherited. Past the expiry date the build fails until the entry
is removed or renewed. Expiries are capped at 180 days out and warn 21 days before.
An override in pnpm-workspace.yaml (or website/pnpm-workspace.yaml) is always the
first choice — an exception is only for a finding no override can fix. Adding one
here when a version bump would do buys a re-decision date instead of a fix.
Trees: "." is the Electron app, "website" is the isolated docs sub-project.
